sources_note: Imported from the research handover by tools/import_handover.js. CONFIRMED = official OEM or government document; BUILDER_MEASURED = measured by a body builder on a built vehicle (dimensioned layout drawing), between CONFIRMED and ESTIMATED; ESTIMATED = planning value, derived figure or non-official source; UNKNOWN = not found (value null). living_x0_from_rear.method: Living area starts 40 mm wall + 20 mm inside the rear face (xr = xB + t + 0.02)

usable_length.method: GLB living length: from 60 mm inside the rear wall to 360 mm behind the cab-seat backs (cab length estimated: vans 1650–1800 ±250 mm, buses 2100–2600 ±300 mm). Not a measurement.

usable_width.source: Azad Automotive Customs, "Voyager VIP on Force Urbania" (WB 4400), dimensioned top-view layouts, PDF pages 2–3, Oct 2026; data/reference/builders/azad_voyager-vip_urbania-4400_oct-2026.pdf
usable_width.method: Revised default: exterior width 1905 × 78.8 %, the finished-width ratio measured by Azad Automotive Customs on the Urbania 4400 (1651 / 2095). Not measured on this vehicle.

expected_error.text: −50/+150 mm (ratio from one Urbania build; bare-panel widths can be about 150 mm more, e.g. the Force Traveller cargo leaflet gives 1680 mm on a 1925 mm body)

alt_estimates.source: research/project_files/donors.json (ObjectWeave seed 2026-10-08); models/source/vehicles.py (GLB build input, 19 Nov 2026)
alt_estimates.method: Exterior width 1905 − 2 × 40 mm assumed wall (donors.json shellWallEachSideMm 40 ±15). No taper, trim or tumblehome allowed for.

expected_error.text: −200/+30 mm (Force delivery-van leaflet shows 1680 mm cargo width on the 1925 mm Traveller body, i.e. up to ~165 mm less than this estimate)

standing_height.source: Tata Motors Winger 12S page (internal height line) as recorded in models/source/vehicles.py on 19 Nov 2026; a web search on 21 Nov 2026 also returned 'internal height 1900 mm, floor height 495 mm' for https://busesandvans.tatamotors.com/product/tata-winger-12s. glb.origin: Mid-length of the body, on the centreline, at ground level. NOT the front axle and NOT the repo origin (rear bumper). Repo x (mm from rear bumper) = (glb_x_m + L/2) × 1000.
glb.layout_as_built: fixed rear transverse double bed 1825x1400 mm over a storage garage; kitchenette 1100 mm with 2-burner cooktop and sink; dinette 1700x1175 mm (2 facing benches + removable table, converts to a 2nd bed); tall wardrobe; overhead lockers; water tank 173 L, 1 x 100 Ah LiFePO4 battery + panel, 230 V shore inlet, 2 x 2 kg extinguishers (driver + kitchen/door)
